title: As Reddit Stock Falls, CEO Questions Value of Google's AI Overviews - Slashdot
excerpt: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman criticized Google's AI Overviews for summarizing publishers' content without delivering the traffic benefits of traditional search, arguing that users increasingly value Reddit's human perspectives and firsthand experiences. content_html:
Reddit CEO Steve Huffman criticized Google's AI Overviews for summarizing publishers' content without delivering the traffic benefits of traditional search, arguing that users increasingly value Reddit's human perspectives and firsthand experiences. Ars Technica reports: First, there was a letter to investors (PDF), wherein Huffman spun his narrative about Reddit's value proposition and general strategic direction amid the proliferation of AI tools. He wrote: "As the internet becomes flooded with synthetic content, people are craving real human perspective. We are the antidote to an automated web. AI compresses the internet into summaries. Reddit delivers the opposite: deep discussions, passionate debates, and lived experiences. People don't want a summary of Reddit; they want Reddit."

The letter also said: "As AI makes information more abundant, the challenge is no longer finding content -- it's finding context, personal opinion, and first-hand accounts. Everything online feels flat, polished, generated, or sponsored, so consumers are overwhelmed and increasingly skeptical. We've never had more information, but we've never trusted it less."

And then, in comments around the earnings report, he added: "What we see is, 10 blue links has driven tremendous value and growth to the broader ecosystem... from where we sit, AI Overviews has yet to make a similar level of positive impact, and I think that's consistent across the broader landscape, right? As businesses, publishers, retailers, we're still looking for that win-win."

Reddit shares nevertheless fell more than 20 percent as investors worried that unstable Google referrals could undermine its growth, even after a strong earnings report.

content_html_zh: Reddit 首席执行官 Steve Huffman 批评 Google 的 AI Overviews 总结了出版商的内容，却没有提供传统搜索的流量优势，他认为用户越来越重视 Reddit 的人文视角和第一手经验。 Ars Technica 报道：首先，有一封致投资者的信 (PDF)，霍夫曼在信中阐述了 Reddit 在人工智能工具激增的情况下的价值主张和总体战略方向。 他写道：“随着互联网上充斥着合成内容，人们渴望真正的人类视角。 我们是自动化网络的解药。 人工智能将互联网压缩为摘要。 Reddit 提供的恰恰相反：深入的讨论、激烈的辩论和生活体验。 人们不需要 Reddit 的摘要；他们想要的是 Reddit 的摘要。他们想要 Reddit。” 信中还表示：“随着人工智能使信息更加丰富，挑战不再是寻找内容，而是寻找背景、个人观点和第一手资料。 网上的一切都感觉平淡、精致、生成或赞助，因此消费者不知所措，并越来越怀疑。 我们从未获得过更多的信息，但我们也从未如此信任它。” 然后，在围绕收益报告的评论中，他补充道：“我们看到的是，10 个蓝色链接为更广泛的生态系统带来了巨大的价值和增长...... 从我们的角度来看，人工智能概述尚未产生类似水平的积极影响，我认为这在更广泛的领域是一致的，对吧？ 作为企业、出版商、零售商，我们仍在寻求双赢。” 尽管如此，Reddit 股价还是下跌了 20% 以上，因为投资者担心，即使在发布了强劲的盈利报告之后，不稳定的 Google 推荐可能会损害其增长。
